items.problem: Initialize-UwpMigration copies UWP build artifacts (obj/, bin/, Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs) into the project; the SDK-style WinUI csproj auto-globs them and the build fails with CS0579 Duplicate 'TargetFrameworkAttribute'.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 37 CS0579 from Tasks\obj\...\.NETCore,Version=v5.0.AssemblyAttributes.cs; turns 38-43 manual cleanup.
items.root_cause: Step-1 copy filter matches by extension only and recurses into obj/bin; the bin/obj exclusion only guards the later namespace-rewrite pass.
items.change: Add an artifact-directory guard (bin/obj/.vs/.git/.github/.copilot/.uwp-source) and an *AssemblyInfo.cs guard to the step-1 copy Where-Object so stale generated sources are never copied.
items.expected_effect: Migrated projects no longer contain UWP build artifacts; no CS0579/duplicate-attribute failures; no manual <Compile Remove> work.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no .cs under bin/obj is present in the project and dotnet build does not emit CS0579; Validate-UwpMigration build PASS without artifact cleanup turns.

items.problem: Migrating a kept in-process IBackgroundTask to packaged WinUI 3 fails on OnBackgroundActivated (CS0246) and on inProcessServer manifest placement (AppX 0x80080204 / 0xC00CE169).
items.root_cause: Background Tasks pattern only points to BackgroundTaskBuilder/Task Scheduler and omits the keep-the-in-process-task path: OnBackgroundActivated does not exist on WinUI 3 App, and windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer is a package-level (not application-level) manifest extension.
items.change: Extend MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '## Background Tasks' with a concrete sub-block: do not add Application.OnBackgroundActivated; place windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer under the package-root <Extensions>; include the correct manifest snippet and the exact error strings it prevents.
items.expected_effect: Future migrations wire in-process background tasks correctly in one pass instead of 3 failed launch cycles.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any background-task scenario, App.xaml.cs contains no OnBackgroundActivated, the manifest has package-level inProcessServer, and Test-AppLaunch reports status=running on the first attempt.

deferred_to_human: Headless capture limitation: WinUI composition screenshots are blank and the UWP CoreWindow exposes no XAML UIA tree, blocking per-scenario UWP behavioral baselines. This is an eval-skill / harness concern (winui3-parity-check / uwp-app-runner), out of scope for the migration skill.

Validate-UwpMigration flags MIGRATION-MAPPING.md rows that include build-output paths (bin\AppX\Assets) as Status=copied, forcing a manual flip; consider seeding the mapping from source-only paths (harness/tooling scope).
